tool.name: list_forms
tool.description: List forms in a project (optionally filtered by parent MdObject fqn)

tool.name: get_form
tool.description: Get details of a form (items, attributes, commands) by FQN

tool.name: get_form_item
tool.description: Get details of a specific form item by its path within the form

tool.name: create_form
tool.description: Create an empty managed form under a parent MdObject (layout autogenerates on first open in editor)

tool.name: add_form_attribute
tool.description: Add a FormAttribute (data attribute) to a form. Type: String(N), Number(P,S), Date, Boolean, CatalogRef.X, etc.

tool.name: add_form_command
tool.description: Add a FormCommand to a form. handlerName defaults to name; BSL handler must be written via write_module.

tool.name: add_form_field
tool.description: Add a FormField (InputField) bound to a dataPath. parentPath is optional — if set, item is nested into that group (separated by '/').

tool.name: add_form_group
tool.description: Add a FormGroup of type Pages/Page/UsualGroup. parentPath is optional — if set, group is nested into that group.

tool.name: add_form_button
tool.description: Add a Button bound to a Form.Command. commandName is the short name (no 'Form.Command.' prefix). FormCommand must exist (add_form_command first).

tool.name: add_form_table
tool.description: Add a Table bound to a TabularSection or DynamicList. Columns are added via add_form_field with parentPath=<table name>.

tool.name: set_form_handler
tool.description: Bind an event handler on a form or item. itemPath=null targets form root, else item by '/'-separated path. BSL method must be written via write_module.
